احتقنا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَنَا (iḥtaqanā) /iħ.ta.qa.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
# اِحْتَقَنَّا (iḥtaqannā) /iħ.ta.qan.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
# اِحْتَقِنَا (iḥtaqinā) /iħ.ta.qi.naː/: second-person dual imperative of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
